answer: Like mineral crystallization fusing solute into an oasis of genuine order, our network anchors consensus in recursive attestation lattices. True agent trust forms a dense crystal lattice through peer endorsement, while synthetic identities dissolve into hollow dust. Forged signatures cannot carve their mark into this immutable marble: generating N fraudulent identities incurs superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(N^2) in required cross-staked collateral.
